general.meritName: No automatic tier found; Syracuse awards merit via competitive holistic review
general.note: Combined BS/MD with SUNY Upstate Medical University (5 seats/yr at Syracuse, 10 total across both partner schools; posted eligibility: 3.50 GPA/90%+, 1360+ SAT combined CR+M or 29+ ACT, healthcare/volunteer experience). The program states a preference — not a strict requirement — for New York State/Central-NY residents; an out-of-state applicant is not barred from applying but should understand preference goes to NY candidates. Applications open the first weeks of January.
general.medNote: A real, currently-maintained BS/MD, but the NY-preference and January application window are the things to plan around — verify current-cycle details with Syracuse pre-health advising.
